test_title: SSC CHSL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The police could not / hold on the people / for long as they / gathered in large numbers
solution: The erroneous part of the sentence is: **hold on the people** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct phrase is "**hold onto**" and not "**hold on**" in this context. • "**Hold on**" is used to indicate waiting or pausing, whereas "hold onto" means to maintain or keep a firm grip on something or someone. • Therefore, the correct sentence should be: *The police could not hold onto the people for long as they gathered in large numbers.* Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer which contains the error. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __ • "**for long as they**" is a correct phrase and does not contain any grammatical errors. • "**The police could not**" is a correct phrase and does not contain any grammatical errors. • "**gathered in large numbers**" is a correct phrase and does not contain any grammatical errors. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • इस संदर्भ में सही वाक्यांश **"hold onto" **है, न कि **"hold on".** • **"Hold on" **का प्रयोग प्रतीक्षा या ठहरने के लिए किया जाता है, जबकि **"hold onto" **का अर्थ होता है किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को सख्ती से पकड़े रहना। • इसलिए, सही वाक्य होगा: पुलिस को लोगों को लंबे समय तक नहीं रोकना संभव था क्योंकि वे बड़ी संख्या में इकट्ठा हुए। इसलिए,** विकल्प 2 **ही सही उत्तर है जिसमें त्रुटि होती है। e4:Taca, The correct answer is: **he must have studied well**
